title: Create a minimal package.json in a directory
description: Writes a minimal, workspace-scoped package.json into a target directory, with optional fields for deployable Node packages and dependency versions copied from the root package.json.

examples.description: Creates libs/tools/package.json with the workspace scope and default version.
Creates a public package.json with an explicit version.

examples.command: nx g node-plugin:package-json apps/cybertecpty --name cybertecpty --main=server/server.mjs --nodeEngine="^20.19.0 || ^22.12.0 || ^24.0.0" --startScript="node server/server.mjs" --dependencies=@angular/common,@angular/core --overwrite
examples.description: Creates a deployable Angular SSR app's package.json, copying dependency versions from the root package.json.

dir.description: Directory the package.json is created in, relative to the workspace root.
dir.x-prompt: Which directory should the package.json be created in?

name.description: Package name without the workspace npm scope. The final name is `<workspaceScope>/<name>`.
name.x-prompt: What is the package name (without the workspace scope)?

dependencies.description: Dependency names to copy from the root package.json's `dependencies`/`devDependencies` into the generated file's `dependencies`. Throws if any name isn't found in either map.

main.description: Entry point written to `main`. Omitted when not provided.

nodeEngine.description: Semver range written to `engines.node`. Omitted when not provided.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing package.json at the resolved path. Without this, an existing file is left untouched (with a warning). This is a full replace, not a merge.

private.description: Marks the package private. Omitted entirely (not written as false) when set to false.

startScript.description: Command written to `scripts.start`. Omitted when not provided.
